english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a fabricated thing or an untrue claim.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 hai6 gaa2 ge3

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something not real and can also describe someone or something as insincere.

exampleSentences.english: This designer bag is fake, so don't buy it.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個名牌袋係假㗎，唔好買。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 ming4 paai4 doi6 hai6 gaa2 gaa3 m4 hou2 maai5

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something fake or not genuine.

exampleSentences.english: This certificate is fake; it's a phantom document.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 zing3 syu1 hai6 gaa2 ge3

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken adjective for something fake, not genuine, or broadly bogus.

exampleSentences.english: This bag is bogus, so don't buy it.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 go3 doi2 hai6 gaa2 ge3 m4 hou2 maai5

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something fake, false, or not genuine.

exampleSentences.english: This claim is spurious, so don't believe it.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢個講法係假嘅，唔好信。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei1 go3 gong2 faat3 hai6 gaa2 ge3 m4 hou2 seon3

english.note: Use this when the emphasis is that something is not genuine or is a cheap imitation.

exampleSentences.english: These branded sneakers are plastic, so don’t buy them.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢對名牌波鞋係假嘅，唔好買。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 deoi3 meng4 paai4 bo1 haai4 hai6 gaa2 ge3 m4 hou2 maai5
